keyEvents.text: Telasco Segovia (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 1, Charlotte FC 0. Ian Fray (Inter Miami CF) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Sergio Reguilón (Inter Miami CF).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Gonzalo Luján replaces Sergio Reguilón because of an injury.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 2, Charlotte FC 0. Luis Suárez (Inter Miami CF) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Germán Berterame following a corner.
